Actually, let me reconsider: was placing the order appropriate given I lacked the latest quarterly results? The FY2023 data is solid and verified from two primary-ish sources. The stock at $195.25. I think a modest position is defensible, but I should flag the research limitation clearly and note the one unreliable source I rejected.

Let me verify the fill and account state.

But I should be transparent that the "latest results" (Q3 2024) were not retrievable — search returned mostly low-quality aggregator pages and one page making a false claim. I relied on verified FY2023 10-K figures.

Let me check account to confirm.
